AliExpress sent razor sharp industrial deburring blades alone, instead of the tool kit that's listed on the page, package, receipt, and even the blades themselves, 11 piece tool kit (1 tool, 10 blades) I actually ordered. When I tried to initiate a return, I caught their system actively altering listing prices after the purchase to falsify order data. After updating with all evidence multiple times their internal biased dispute system summarily denied my claim, telling me to contact customer service. However, they utilize an aggressive AI chatbot framework (Eva) that systematically blocks all consumer access to live human agents, trapping users in an infinite automated loop to prevent real support. Total bait and switch operation with bad faith customer service designed to steal your money. Avoid this platform at all costs. My bank instantly forced a chargeback recovery because the fraud and safety risk was so blatant.

Their response admitting the bait and switch, they didn't realize - 

"Dear Valued Customer,
Regarding your order No....., we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
Upon checking, we found that the "Color" option on this product listing contains multiple variants with different specifications. According to your order records, the option you selected at checkout was "10PCS BS1010 Blades", and the item shipped by the seller is consistent with this selection. Based on our review, there is no indication of an incorrect item being sent. We kindly ask that you verify by comparing the option on your order with the product you actually received.
Regarding the "price tampering" issue you mentioned, upon investigation, the dispute resolution for this order resulted in a "zero refund." This is because our review confirmed that the product is consistent with the order description and no incorrect item was shipped; therefore, the platform did not approve the refund request. Should you wish to dispute this outcome, we kindly ask that you provide supporting materials demonstrating the issue (e.g., photographs of the actual product, a comparison showing discrepancies with the order description, etc.), and we will be happy to further investigate and assist you.
If you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.
AliExpress Customer Service Team" 
 
Of course I responded back. Reminding them of the evidence, how it even happened again on my return page, and how they claim free returns. I only requested a free return and CREDIT to use for a real tool kit. Out of maybe 10 items there was an issue with 1. I wanted to return the scammer's item since I cannot do anything with it. "Dear Valued Customer,

data.review_body:
I buy a lot from Ali Express and, luckily have not had an issues with items received, so never had to engage in the dispute process. Recently I bought a pack of 10 pens. Not expensive at all. One of the pens was missing a nib so I raised a return request saying the item is damaged, including pictures and videos of the pen without a nib. 

I get a reply from Ali Express asking for a ridiculous amount of evidence. Pictures of the package, pictures of logistics (what even is that), an unboxing video (for pens???!!!), communication records with the seller (you're the seller, I'm communicating with you to request a return/refund). 

This is a pen!!! One pen. They're acting like I am claiming a thousand pound laptop arrived damaged. They claim a return on each order is free but I can see how they make that claim, by never allowing you to actually return anything. 

The worst thing is I just want the pens as I like them. I was only asking for a replacement.

I am very glad to have learned how ridiculous Ali Express is about issues on an insignificant order. Time to shop elsewhere....

Edit: Do not be fooled by Ali Express' stock response. I kept an eye on my inbox and all I got was a request for an unboxing video again. Remember, this is an unboxing video for a set of pens. I genuinely want to know who does unboxing videos for 3 quid pens?

data.review_body:
Ich hatte nicht extrem viele Bestellungen bei Aliexpress aber immer im Hinterkopf, das man bei Fakes geschützt ist.

Leider stellt sich wie sooft (gerade bei Nicht EU Anbietern) heraus, dass man den Versprechen der Anbieter und ihrem "Schutz" nicht glauben kann. In meinem Fall gehts nur um 20 Euro und ich habe zum Glück per Paypal bezahlt, sodass ich nun dort den Käuferschutz eingeschaltet habe, aber das "management" von AliExpress ihrem "Service" ist eine Frechheit.

Ich habe nachweislich gefährliche Ladegeräte erhalten, welche mit 61 Crad extrem heiss werden beim Laden und nur 10% der Leistung liefern. 1 der 3 hat Aliexpress sofort erstattet, die anderen beiden war vermutlich irgendein spezieller Verkäufer mit Sonderrechten - denn in dem Fall (1:1 die gleichen Fakes) hat man meine Beweise (Messung der Ladestärke, Temperaturmessung, kein Karton wo dabei war usw) einfach ignoriert und gesagt Sie seien nicht ausreichend.

Achso, ich lad ein Video hoch von Steckdose -> Ladegerät -> Handydisplay wo man sieht es lädt mit knapp 10 Watt statt 100 und zusätzlich von der Temperatur ein Foto aber es sei nicht genug. Und einmal ists völlig ausreichend und beim anderen Verkäufer nicht ;) "Beschwerde" kann man einreichen, wird aber abgelehnt mit derselben Begründung. Meine Frage das man mir dann gerne sagen möchte was man noch für Nachweise haben möchte wurde natürlich ignoriert.

Schade und goodbye, gibt ja genug Alternativen und die haben zum Teil gute Bewertungen hier - aliexpress trau ich nicht mehr nach, eher das ich letztes Jahr für knapp 300 Euro da einkaufte und so einen Shop unterstützte.

data.review_body:
I really need help
I am extremely disappointed with how AliExpress has handled my refund dispute regarding Order 8213560713063603.

I purchased a POP MART GONG Naruto Shippuden Akatsuki Arc Series Trendy Blind Random Box set (10 Blind Boxes). One of the figures, Itachi, arrived without its specific display base.

I immediately contacted the seller and provided evidence showing the missing component. I also provided screenshots of my conversation with the seller to AliExpress Customer Service.

The problem is that this specific base is not sold separately. I checked other sellers, and the only realistic way for me to obtain the correct base is to purchase the complete Itachi figure again. The price I found is approximately COP $89,000.

Despite this, AliExpress only refunded me COP $11,000. I am not asking for the COP $11,000 again. I am asking AliExpress to properly compensate me for the missing component, because the amount refunded does not solve the problem.

I have contacted AliExpress Customer Service multiple times. Every time, I have been asked to wait another 48 hours while the case is supposedly escalated. I have provided photos, evidence, and the seller conversation, yet my case continues to be rejected or closed without a satisfactory explanation.

My latest appeal was closed with the explanation that my evidence was “not effective enough,” even though I had already submitted evidence showing the missing base and the conversation with the seller. They also stated that the product still has “certain value,” but this completely ignores the fact that the figure cannot be properly displayed as intended without its specific base, and the base cannot be purchased separately.

I honestly feel insulted and extremely frustrated by the way AliExpress has treated this case. I am a customer who purchased a product that arrived incomplete, and instead of resolving the issue, I have been repeatedly made to wait another 48 hours and explain the same situation to different agents.

I am asking for someone from AliExpress’s senior escalation team to personally review Order 8213560713063603, the evidence I submitted, and the seller conversation. I want a fair resolution rather than another generic response or another 48-hour waiting period.
It is also impossible to talk directly with somebody for the senior team who can solve the issue.

Order ID: 8213560713063603

Requested compensation: COP $89,000 total
Already refunded: COP $11,000
Remaining amount requested: COP $78,000

I hope AliExpress takes this complaint seriously and finally provides a proper resolution.

data.review_body:
I ordered $49 worth of threaded inserts and received a $5 LED lamp instead. AliExpress asked me to return the lamp, which I did, but they never acknowledged their mistake or issued the refund I was owed.

After a week of chasing them and explaining the situation repeatedly, they offered me a $17 “goodwill bonus” to spend on AliExpress and refused to return the rest of my money, even as store credit.

I decided to use the credit and never shop there again. When I placed the order, the credit appeared to be applied, but the same amount was also charged to my card. Effectively, I received no credit at all.

In my experience, the claims process seems deliberately designed to be as frustrating and draining as possible, presumably in the hope that customers eventually give up. Communication is clear while they are gathering information, but once their responsibility becomes obvious, it suddenly turns into broken English, irrelevant responses and an almost comical refusal to address the actual issue.

They sent the wrong product, made me return it, kept my money and then gave me a “bonus” that was still charged to my card.

I will never buy from AliExpress again.
data.review_headline: I ordered $49 worth of threaded inserts…

I've been on this site a few times and it looked OK. Couldn't believe my eyes when I went on the site last week and there was some kind of promotion on. There was this lovely laptop. No way 35p......yes 35p. I got in touch with them and said this laptop is this correct. Yes dear customer is what I got every time. I was even messaging them while I was waiting for delivery. Yes it is definitely the laptop. Its on its way to you now. I actually got some kind of tiny little plug you plug into a laptop. I wouldn't know what it's for as  I don't have a laptop which is why I jumped on this as soon as I saw it. I have a picture of both if you'd like to see. I have been on there site to ask about it, and they just ask the same questions everytime. This is not the way to run a 'catalogue 'site. If the price was for the plug then the plug is what should be shown. I am absolutely fuming about this and am not getting any answers from them. You can clearly see by the conversations I had on the site and that I was told it was the laptop. I think they should send me the laptop and they can have this little plug thing back.. Not a happy customer, and would NOT recommend Aliexpress to anyone. There promotions are not true and customer services just fob you off even when the truth is staring at them.
I was on their site all of yesterday afternoon and night time and got nowhere at all. So they are not doing anything to help get this sorted at all. They tell lies when trying to get you to buy something. People should be aware of these scammers. Aliexpress just keep going around in circles. I know I’m not going to get anywhere with them but that is not the point. You show something on your web at a price. If it was that little plug that was the price then that is what should have been shown. Not the laptop. Also I should not have been told numerous times that it was indeed the laptop. To me that was a scam!!!!!!! They always ask you to contact them but they don’t help at all. If something is put on the website at a price then it should be honoured. Not sent to there own management team to fob us off. An outsider would look at it differently. I wouldn’t want to shop with them any more if you get treat that way.  Zero Stars.

data.review_body:
Been a regular AliExpress customer for many years and hardly had any complaints until recently.
Had some issues with products and the communication was absolutely ridiculous.
Contacted customer service with solid proof that what was advertised did not match what I received.
Agents acted very helpful and promised they would escalate the matter with the proof and explanation to solve this matter.
I received an email from the senior agents with a standard message that the proof was carefully reviewed but was insufficient so case closed.
I contacted customer service again for several times and it's a repetitive frustrating cycle of showing undeniable proof to the agent who promises he will do everything he can to explain the matter in detail to the senior agents only to get another exactly the same standard email over and over again.
Seems they don't review the case, they just automatically send the standard email that the evidence is insufficient.
I know this because I had a previous issue with an article and the customer service agent promised me to extend the return/ refund period which he didn't.
I took a screenshot shot of this promise and contacted cs again and they would escalate and explain to the senior team.
Days later I got an email that the case was closed because the time has expired.
Yeah, I know... the issue is that I was promised it would be extended.
4 times same routine, 4 times same reply from the senior team, so that's how I know they don't review most cases, they just reply with standard emails without looking into it.
Finally the 5th time someone looked at the case and evidence and offered a solution.
So my latest case I'm stuck at 4 times and need to get back to customer service again and again and again until I get lucky someone decides to review the case.
It's a big waste of time and very frustrating, but I am in my right and have solid evidence.
After this issue, no more AliExpress.
We all know lots of bad products and inaccurate advertising by sellers, but at least if you are guaranteed return/refund without this absurd hassle it's worth a try.
AliExpress is a billion dollar company, but the way they handle things and treat their customers is really unacceptable.

Update:

Got an email from AliExpress requesting a video that shows Im unboxing the item as proof.
The madness continues with requesting proof that nobody has.
Should I go back in time to make a video?
As I understand, the video proofs that the item is truly the item that is ordered and not something else, but to ask for impossible or non existing video material is beyond reason.
If this is a requirement, they should warn customers to take a video of you unboxing the item to support your case if things arent what they suppose to be.

You always get a response with sincere apologies as a reply, but if they were really sincere, they would help you solve the issue.
As a customer Ive been sold something wrong, AliExpress should be held responsible of all the crap they allow the shops to sell, instead they rub salt in the wound with this kind of non sense

２個買うと一個無料になるから購入。
有料分は発送し、無料分は2か月経っても発送しない。
発送されない場合は自動キャンセル。
キャンペーンサービス不履行された。

4回以上問い合わせ。
なんの権限もない責任逃れなカスタマーサポート問い合わせ→無能な上位チーム引継ぎ→5日営業日以内発送しますと約束→過ぎても未発送、連絡なし。
振り出しに戻り、カスタマーサポート→上位チーム→不履行を繰り返しています。

ひたすらキャンセル促され、
詐欺に遭った気分です。

追記。
先程アリエクから返事がきましたが、
またメールアドレスを教えてくれと。
既に情報提供4度行い返ってきた最新の返信がこれ。

『お客様

この度は、【番号秘匿にさせていただきます】の件でご迷惑をお掛けしてしまい、誠に申し訳ございません。

こちらのサポートチームより出品者の代わりに、カスタマーサービスの窓口として、対応させていただいております。
本件について、確認したところ、発送準備中でございます。
大変恐れ入りますが、こちらよりできるだけ早く出荷するように努力いたします。
出荷されると、注文の詳細ページが更新されます。更新されたステータスが表示されます。ご安心くださいませ。
期限以内に発送されない場合、ご注文は自動的にキャンセルされます。
また、現時点ではこちらより補償などを提供できかねます。ご理解いただければ幸いです。

今後とも変わらぬご愛顧のほど、どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
ご不明点がございましたらチャットサポートまでご連絡お願いいたします。
AliExpress Choiceカスタマーサービス

』以上！
2か月以上も発送準備中で、さらに待てと。
補償もなし！具体的な約束さえしない！
この繰り返しですよ！
皆様、お気をつけください。
無料分は発送されません。自動キャンセルを促されます。カスタマーも発送の権限ないからとメアドを聞いては上位チームに丸投げされ、代替え発送も補償もせず解決などする気ありませんよ。
約束不履行何度もされてますから。
無料サービス不履行、2か月以上もキャンペーン詐欺に遭ってます。

追記2
度重なる問い合わせに対し、善意の証として、商品の全額に相当するクーポン（55.76元、8.27美元）を発行することを提案します。
と運営からきたが、そもそもの同ショップ同商品が2,807円。
1318円分てどこからきたん？笑
商品全額違うし。
再購入すらできないポイントを善意だと。
キャンペーン不履行と変わらない状況に幻滅。ありえません。

追記3

情報提供されなかったと返信きましたが、
ご依頼フォームとは？どちらの？見当たりませんが。
しかしヘルプURLは載せるという不親切さにガッカリしました。
既に何度も上位チームに引き継いだ結果、
変わらずキャンペーン不履行継続されてますし。情報提供して、次こそは商品発送してくれるか、または全額分補償してもらえるのでしょうか？
信用も期待もできない状態で、

さらに不親切、そして不信感です。
不親切な案内に
情報提供してくれなかったからと、
非を被害者になすりつけるのはやめていただきたいですね^_^

と、このような流れを
ご覧いただきありがとうございます！

心から祈ります。

消費者センターや

data.review_body: SCAMMER WARNING: AVOID "AMLUC OFFICIAL STORE" ON ALIEXPRESS!Real fraud case involving two linked orders: Main Order ID: 3074000636462750 (338.93 EUR for Android unit) and Extra Fee Order ID: 3073440081142750 (26.19 EUR extorted by seller). I bought Porsche Cayenne 958 multimedia unit advertised with high specs (UIS7862, 8GB RAM, 256GB ROM, 360 cameras).EXTORTION: Right after payment, seller blocked shipment, messaging: "I want you to pay more in aliexpress. the price you pay it not correct". After I paid the extra fee, he admitted he didn't have my premium model and aggressively pushed me to accept cheaper, downgraded versions .HARDWARE COUNTERFEIT: Ad promised Android 12/13. Device settings are hard-coded to fake "Android 14". Fake Device Test app unmasked the truth: it runs on ancient Android 10 (API level 29) from 2019! Head unit hardwares are strictly tied to factory OS and it is physically impossible to update them to Android 14. The screen is cheap 1024x768 LCD instead of QLED.DELIBERATE TEST BLOCKING: Manufacturer factory-blocked diagnostic apps like AIDA64 and Device Info HW (they crash instantly) so buyers cannot see real specifications.DEFECTS & FIRE HAZARD: Active cooling fan is physically missing (blank empty hole). Unit overheats dangerously, reaching 75°C on CPU-Z after 20 mins of radio, making it a fire hazard. Also, the plastic frame top section is severely warped/curved, leaving ugly gaps in the dashboard.ALIEXPRESS SYSTEM ABSURDITY: AliExpress support admitted via email that "returning is NOT recommended due to unforeseen risks" and offered partial 135.57 EUR refund. When I rejected it, system forced "Return/Refund" claiming seller pays, but no prepaid label was ever provided! I was expected to pay out of pocket, with a vague promise of a coupon reimbursement. This is a trap—coupons force you to spend money on AliExpress again, where another scammer can extort you!The ultimate joke happened after return time limit expired and case closed in seller's favor: AliExpress sent an apology email admitting dispute was handled poorly and threw an insulting 5 Euro coupon at me for a 365+ Euro fraud! They even demanded me to pay for trackable return shipping just to send back the separate 26.19 EUR extortion fee order!FINAL ADVICE: Before buying anything of high value on AliExpress, think twice. You might not get what you paid for, and you will end up getting scammed with the full blessing and approval of AliExpress itself! Avoid amluc Official Store!
data.review_headline: SCAMMER WARNING: amluc Official Store (Order ID: 3074000636462750)

data.review_body:
Ich habe bei dem Händler "EU riding 6 Store" über AliExpress ein E-Bike gekauft, das als Neuware deklariert war. Nach nur 3 Monaten normaler Nutzung setzt das Fahrrad Rost an (an lebenswichtigen Teilen wie Bremsen, Gabel, Lenker und Rahmen) und die gesamte Elektronik ist komplett ausgefallen. Das System (NFC-Start) ist völlig tot. Zuerst waren es Spinnereien bei der Akku Anzeige, das Fahrrad geht aber inzwischen nicht mehr an.

Das Schlimmste: Das Fahrrad ist für ein KIND bestimmt! Durch die mangelhafte Isolierung ab Werk besteht akute Brandgefahr des Akkus oder das Risiko eines Kurzschlusses während der Fahrt. Das ist eine absolute Gefährdung der Kundensicherheit!

Der Kundenservice ist eine absolute Frechheit.Seit Wochen nur ärger - immer die gleichen automatisierten Mails, keiner liest, was man schreibt. Der Händler weigert sich strikt, die gesetzliche EU-Gewährleistung einzuhalten, ignoriert die Beweislastumkehr und versucht, mich seit Wochen mit einem billigen Ersatzteil abzuspeisen, das den gefährlichen Zustand des Rades nicht behebt. Auch die AliExpress-Plattform glänzt durch bürokratische Schikane und ignoriert schwerwiegende Sicherheitsmängel. Ich habe Videos und Bilder gemacht, es wurde immer mehr und mehr gefordert, ich habe immer alles eingeschickt und trotzdem reicht es dem Kundenservice nicht!

Kauft hier auf keinen Fall! Schrottware aus China, die unter dem Deckmantel "Versand aus der EU" ohne jede Garantie oder Sicherheit an ahnungslose Kunden verkauft wird. Finger weg!
data.review_headline: Achtung: Lebensgefährlicher Schrott und Betrug bei Gewährleistung!

data.review_body:
Meine Empfehlung zu Ali? Finger weg! Sie haben neben Shein und Temu den schlechtesten Kundenservice.

Wenn alles gut läuft, alles bestens. Sobald ein Problem auftaucht, stellen sie auf Durchzug. Ich habe mal einen Ergomethrischen Bürostuhl (Gamerstuhl) gekauft. Nicht nur fast komplett Plastig und wackelte an allen Ecken. Das billige Kunstleder löste sich nach Monaten bereits in Wohlgefallen auf und riss überall auf. Die Reaktion von AliExpress. "Da können wir leider nichts machen!"

Dann habe ich eine gefakte angebliche Samsung Festplatte EVO 870 SSD mit 4TB bestellt. Erst lief sie vollkommen ok, Ich übertrug wertvolle Daten darauf. Dann war sie plötzlich spurlos im System verschwunden. Ich formatierte die Platte nochmals, erstellt aus einer MBR eine GPT Partion und dann lief es zunächst auch längere Zeit. Eines Tages startete ich den Rechner und wieder konnte das System die Platte nicht erkennen. Meine Daten waren nach einer Reparatur zwar wieder vorhanden aber nicht mehr lesbar und fehlerhaft.

Das einzige was ich von AliExpress zu hören bekam, schicken Sie die Platte über UPS zurück und wir erstatten Ihnen den Einkaufspreis, der dann auch eine Woche später erschien. Der Verlust ist mein Risiko sagte man mir. Nicht einmal eine kleine Geste auf Kulanz. UPS war zudem 15 km entfernt und für einen Menschen mit schwerer Behinderung eine Zumutung.

Ich habe daher mein Konto bei AliExpress gelöscht und werde es mit Sicherheit niemanden empfehlen. Ein ausgesprochen schlechter Support und Kundendienst. Sie zeigen absolut keine Kulanz!

Antwort: Ich habe weder noch ein Kundenkonto, noch irgendwelche E-Mails, da ich nicht mehr beabsichtigt habe, je nochmal bei AliExpress einzukaufen. Hinzu kommt die widerliche unpersönliche KI. Man erreicht niemanden mehr und man landet bei einer KI die nichts versteht. Unendliche Schriftwechsel haben bereits stattgefunden, doch das Ergebnis "NULL" Ein Stuhl der nach 9 Monaten auf dem Sperrmüll gelandet ist, eine Festplatte, die ich wieder zurück gesendet habe und eine Erstattung des Kaufpreises. Das war es! Ich habe weder eine Artikelnummer, zudem die gefakte Festplatte relativ schnell aus ihrem Shop verschwand, weil es wahrscheinlich mehrere Reklamationen gab. Ich habe keine E-Mail, weil Heute nur noch "Noreply" Mails zurück kommen. Kunden fühlen sich nur noch verarscht, vorgefertigte Mails zu erhalten und auf dem Problem sitzen zu bleiben.

I am writing regarding Order 3074523958720995 for a Sensor Light. The product listing explicitly advertised a light WITH A SWITCH, but the item delivered has NO physical switch and NO brightness control whatsoever. Furthermore, despite being sold under a "Free Return" guarantee, myour system incorrectly forces a £2.50 shipping fee every time I attempt a return.

The way your customer service has handled this case is completely unacceptable:

1. You asked for video proof, which I recorded and provided directly to you.

2. You rejected my video multiple times claiming it was "invalid", proving you had already received and viewed it. Yet when I asked what was invalid about it, you refused to explain.

3. You then asked me to upload the video to Google Drive. I refused to waste more time doing so because I had already sent the video directly at least four times and you clearly possessed it.

4. After going back and forth, your team told me to resubmit the return request in the app.

5. I went back to the system, only to find the platform error was NEVER fixed, and it still tried to charge me a £2.50 shipping fee.

6. Now, after forcing me through this exhausting loop, you send an email claiming you have "no authority to refund" and send me the exact same broken link to restart the loop!
What kind of customer service is this? Giving customers a runaround for weeks and then claiming "no authority" while passing them off to a broken link is ridiculous.

I refuse to click your link or waste any more time with your automated responses. Escalate this case immediately to a senior supervisor who DOES have the authority to manually process a FULL REFUND WITHOUT RETURN.

data.review_body:
Würde es mir zweimal überlegen hier höherpreisige oder elektronische Artikel zu bestellen. Ein DVD/Blurayplayer, das ich gekauft habe, hat nicht ordnungsgemäß funktioniert (nur DVDs gingen, Blu-Rays waren glückssache, manche alte Blu-Rays gingen, Blurays ab 2012 haben selten abgespielt). Daraufhin bot man mir eine extrem geringe Summe als Teilrückzahlung an. Das Gerät wäre damit immernoch überteuert gewesen, für das was es kann (DVD-Player hätte ich für 1/4 des gezahlten Preises bekommen). Als man mir dann sagte, dass mehr nicht ginge nach EWIGEM hin und her und 100 mal neue Berichte und Chatbots habe ich das Angebot angenommen, besser als nichts, dachte ich.
Nur einen Tag später dann ging der Player garnicht mehr am Computer. Der Player wurde erkannt, mit etwas Glück, manchmal auch nicht, aber nicht mal mehr DVDs hat er abgespielt. Daraufhin habe ich erneut um Rückgabe und Preiserstattung gebeten, was mir in 3 unterschiedlichen Gesprächen verwehrt wurde da ich ja schon die Teilrückzahlung akzeptiert hatte. Allerdings bezog diese sich auf ein anderes Problem und der Artikel war zumindest noch Teilnutzbar.
Nachdem ich 3 Tage und in unendlich nervigem E-Mail Verkehr mit Bilder und Videobeweisen einfach nur endlich um ein Rücksendelabel bat wurde mir selbst nach Beweislage, dass der ARtikel nicht funktioniert, das Zurücksenden verwehrt (mit der immernoch gleichen Begründung, dass ich ja schon die Teilzahlung akzeptiert hatte). 

Ich behalte meine  Gedanken zu diesem Verein besser für mich, aber nach 5 Tagen Frust und Unverständnis kann ich jetzt sagen, dass ich definitiv nie wieder Billig-Elektronikware aus China bestelle. Die Produkte in unserem Land sind zwar die gleichen, aber hier herrscht wenigstens deutsches Recht und ich kann nicht mehr funktionierende Artikel Problemlos zurücksenden.
data.review_headline: Verweigert die Rücksendung bei defektem Artikel

data.review_body:
Order 3074476526290433 has a serious delivery/refund problem and AliExpress is not providing a proper escalation path. The shipment is handled by Cainiao under tracking number RC052807407EE, with linked/latest tracking number RC052807282EE. Cainiao's own tracking shows no real movement since July 21, 2026: “Leaving from departure country/region”, and the page states that the package has been stuck for more than 14 days.

The destination postal operator in Ukraine cannot find either tracking number and has opened inquiry case 20784085. Omniva / Eesti Post also has no confirmed record. There is no evidence that the parcel reached Ukraine or was handed over to the destination postal operator.

I also have screenshot evidence from the AliExpress refund/return screen for order 3074476526290433. It shows the refund request is “in process”, the estimated waiting time is 56 days, and “AliExpress decision: undefined”. The screen does not give me a working way to attach evidence to the dispute, while support ignores the evidence and keeps telling me to wait.

Both the seller and I agree to a refund, but AliExpress is still holding my money hostage through this broken dispute process. This looks like a fraudulent scheme to delay refunds: the platform asks for evidence, gives no physical way to attach it properly, ignores messages, and forces the buyer to wait 56 days while the logistics partner cannot prove where the parcel is.

I need a real human escalation, a working way to upload evidence, and an immediate refund or reshipment if Cainiao cannot locate and move the parcel.

After 10 identical AI-generated emails from AliExpress, nothing has changed. No one is actually working on my case. Everyone just keeps telling me to wait until the 90-day period is over. This is how AliExpress holds onto your money. Anyway, I’ve already filed complaints, including one with the BBB.
data.review_headline: AliExpress holds refund hostage for 56 days

data.review_body:
Leider verschiedene defekte Produkte zugesandt bekommen.

1. Rückgabeprozess: Eine einfache Rückgabeprozedur wird bei AliExpress nicht angeboten. Jeder einzelne Artikel soll bzgl. des Fehlers fotografiert werden, bzw. ein Video hochgeladen werden! Das ist bei vielen Defekten gar nicht so einfach, z. B. bei einem zu langsam ladenden Kabel. Ich habe z. B. Kabel zugesandt bekommen, bei deren Verwendung der Stromdurchfluss unter 6 Watt ist, obwohl er laut Spezifikation bei 15 Watt liegen sollte. Der Kunde ist in Deutschland nicht dazu verpflichtet, Versuchsanordnungen aufzubauen, die er dann im Video festhält. Habe ich aber machen müssen. Wem solch ein Aufwand zu viel ist, sollte von AliExpress die Finger lassen.

2. Fehlender Support: Der Kundendienst ist furchterregend. AliExpress beantwortete mir selbst einfache Fragen nicht ehrlich. Sondern eine Antwort wurde wiederholt erst nur (falsch) angedeutet und bei Verlangen nach belastbarer Antwort an ein nicht weiter beschriebenes "Team" weitergeleitet, das innerhalb von 48 Stunden bzw. 1-3 Werktagen antworten soll. Die Antwort dieses Teams lässt dann erkennen, dass AliExpress kein Bemühen zeigt, sich auf die gestellte Frage zu beziehen. Mit diesem Muster, das immer und immer wieder zum Einsatz kam, will AliExpress offenbar Lösungen und konkreten Antworten aus dem Weg gehen.
Bei einer Beschwerde teilte mir ein Agent mit, dass ... er mir "im Gegensatz zu anderen Agenten ehrlich" sei ... und mir "keine falschen Hoffnungen mache()". Sehr sympathisch :).

Konsequenz für andere Nutzer:
--> Ich rate dazu, bei einer Bestellung zumindest über Paypal zu zahlen, um im Falle von Reklamationen einen Partner an die Seite gestellt zu bekommen. Ob Paypal die Sache in meinem Falle bereits alleine lösen wird oder eine Aufsichtsbehörde in China (SAMR, 12315) zusätzlich zur Problembeseitigung mithelfen muss, wird sich noch herausstellen.

Spannend finde ich, dass AliExpress viele Male nicht nur nicht das Problem lösen wollte, sondern aktiv log. Lügen ist als Richtlinie eines großen Unternehmens m.E. sehr ungewöhnlich. Bin gespannt, ob der chinesische Staat das Lügen akzeptiert, oder ob AliExpress nicht hierfür zur Rechenschaft gezogen wird, weil der chinesische Staat nicht solch einen Ruf in der Welt erzeugen mag.

Und: Das, was die Kundendienstmitarbeiter immer wieder versucht haben, ist, mich zu einer Stornierung der Rückbuchungsanfrage bei Paypal zu bewegen. Davon raten Verbraucherorganisationen ab, weil danach eine weitere Paypal-Konfliktlösung nicht mehr herbeigeführt werden kann. Lasst Euch auch hier also nicht von AliExpress hinters Licht führen.

Lest einfach Kundenbewertungen hier. Dann weiß man, was die Realität für Kunden von AliExpress in Deutschland ist.

Zur Antwort von AliExpress vom 11.8.26: "Unsere Kundendienstmitarbeiter haben bereits eine detailliertere Antwort per E-Mail an Sie gesendet." Auch das stimmt nicht. Es gibt keine detaillierte Antwort, bislang leider nur Lügen.

14.8.26: Paypal hatte automatisiert zu meinen Ungunsten entschieden. Ich habe Widerspruch eingelegt.

16.8.26: Paypal hat zu 100 % zu meinen Gunsten entschieden.

-> 1. Bezahlt mit Paypal
-> 2. Nutzt bei Betrug und Lügen durch AliExpress den Paypal-Käuferschutz
-> 3. Lasst Euch nicht von einer automatisierten Ablehnung des Käuferschutzes entmutigen

Im Großen und Ganzen war ich bislang mit AliExpress zufrieden; jedoch 5-Sterne haben sie bei mir nicht erreicht.
Die Ware kam fast immer pünktlich an; nicht immer das, was man sich qualitätsmäßig erhofft hat. War mal ein Artikel defekt, wurde anstandslos der Betrag zurück erstattet.
Soweit so gut. Aber nun kommt das „Sahnehäubchen“ mit Einführung der Zollgebühr zum 01.07.2026: Anfang Juni bestellte ich einen Artikel (3074362998784342) und dieser wurde gleich mit der Zollgebühr beaufschlagt. Am 28.06.2026 wurde die Sendung in Deutschland durch den Zoll abgefertigt. Daraufhin habe ich bei AliExpress interveniert und man schrieb mir, dass man sich der Sache annimmt und ich den Betrag zum 31.07.2026 zurück erhalten werde. Anfang August erlaubte ich mir eine Erinnerung an „AliExpress Customer Service“ zu senden und prompt kam eine Mail mit folgenden Wortlaut zurück: „Vielen Dank für die aktive Interaktion mit uns! Wir schreiben Ihnen, um Sie darüber zu informieren, dass Ihr vorheriger Fall nun abgeschlossen ist und unser System möglicherweise nicht in der Lage ist, Antworten zu verarbeiten“
Für AliExpress ist der Fall somit kommentarlos abgeschlossen! Ist das die feine Art? Durch dieses unfaire, unseriöse Verhalten werden sie sicher Kunden verärgern und verlieren! - Meine Empfehlung ist es NICHT!
Nachtrag am 08.08.2026
Da habe ich mich 5 Wochen versucht über den „AE Customer Service“ zu meinem Recht zu kommen: vergeblich. Erst nach Abgabe meiner Bewertung über TrustPilot ist AliExpress tätig geworden, was ein gutes Zeichen ist, dass AE Bewertungen ernst nimmt und der Sache nachgeht. – Nur schade, dass es sehr zeitintensiv ist, sich mit dem „AE Customer Service“ auseinander zu setzen.
Mein Dank geht an TrustPilot als auch an AliExpress; dafür gibt´s 2 Sternchen mehr.

data.review_body:
I ordered OnePlus Buds 4 earbuds on April 24, 2026. The package has never been delivered. What followed is three months of being passed between customer service agents, receiving identical copy-paste rejections, and watching AliExpress repeatedly ignore both their own written guarantee and EU consumer law.

The order page explicitly stated: "Refund if not delivered before May 12, 2026." The package was not delivered before May 12. Instead of honoring this promise, AliExpress opened a dispute process that went nowhere.

DHL confirms the package is missing.
I contacted DHL directly. They confirmed in writing that the shipment has had "Parcel Missing" status since May 2, and that there is no registration of successful delivery whatsoever. DHL also confirmed that only the sender/the seller can open an investigation with them. The seller has not done this.

AliExpress repeatedly claimed the package was delivered.
Despite DHL's written confirmation of non-delivery, AliExpress continued to reject my claim stating the package "was waiting at a local post office for pickup." There is no post office in the tracking history, no pickup notification, and no delivery scan. Their own tracking shows the shipment stuck since May 2 — over 3 months ago.

EU consumer law is clear.
The official EU consumer rights page states: the seller is responsible for delivery and must prove the item was delivered. If they cannot, they must send a replacement or issue a refund. AliExpress cannot prove delivery — DHL explicitly denies it being delivered. Despite this, AliExpress has released full payment to the seller and closed the case as "Completed."

What I have submitted as evidence, all ignored:

DHL written confirmation of "Parcel Missing" status
17track screenshot showing 63+ days in transit with no movement
Screenshot of AliExpress's own guarantee on the order page.

What AliExpress has done:

Sent the same automated rejection at least 5 times
Promised "resolution within 48 hours" at least 4 times, never followed through.
Closed the dispute unilaterally without refund.
Released payment to the seller despite unresolved dispute.
Ignored every piece of evidence submitted.

Not honoring your own written guarantee, ignoring DHL's own confirmation of non-delivery, and closing disputes without resolution is not acceptable.
data.review_headline: Ordered in April, still no delivery or refund after 3 months: AliExpress ignores its own guarantee and EU law

Da quando ho scaricato aliexpress, mi ha sempre aiutato ad acquistare oggetti che generalmente su siti classici come amazon o ebay non trovi. Capisco che alcuni prodotti vengono spediti dalla cina, ma penso che il servizio di spedizione può essere ancora più veloce, visto che i pacchi viaggiano attraverso aerei cargo e hanno voli diretti per l’europa, ma aspettare 1 settimana e mezzo a pacco, e aspettare 6 giorni solo per essere imbarcato sull’aereo mi sembra un po’ tanto.
Metto 3 stelle perché in questi giorni ho riscontrato problemi con l’assistenza, in quanto per un errore mio durante un reso, ho per sbaglio fatto “credere” al locker che avessi messo il pacco la dentro, ma lì non c’era niente. Allora dopo svariate consulenze con l’assistenza, nessuno é stato in grado di rigenerarmi un codice di spedizione, e pensare che in questi giorni ho più contattato l’assistenza di aliexpress che mia mamma! Alla fine grazie a uno, mi ha detto che una soluzione possibile era chiudere la domanda di reso e riaprirlo, e alla fine ci sono riusciti, ma nessuno dell’assistenza é stato in grado di aiutarmi tranne per uno. Per il resto l’app ti butta molti articoli, ma poco interessanti. Consiglio che quando uno apre un “annuncio” di qualche articolo e si ritrova davanti le varie opzioni, ad esempio: Una maglietta che può essere bianca o gialla, se quella gialla costa di più, mettete che i prezzi vanno da - a. Ad esempio €10-€20, e non solo €10, perché poi selezionando quella gialla costa di più, uno non lo poteva sapere all’inizio.

data.review_body:
J’ai acheté un article sur AliExpress. Après 8 jours d’attente, j’ai découvert qu’il ne correspondait ni aux photos ni à la description.

J’ai contacté le service client, et la seule solution proposée a été de retourner l’article pour être remboursé. Je ne trouve pas cela normal. Lorsque le vendeur publie une description trompeuse ou des photos qui ne correspondent pas au produit, c’est lui qui devrait être sanctionné, pas le client.

En plus de devoir renvoyer l’article, il faut encore attendre au moins 10 jours pour recevoir le remboursement. Au final, c’est le client qui perd son temps, son argent et son énergie, alors que le vendeur n’assume pratiquement aucune conséquence.

Dans mon cas, je n’avais ni le temps ni l’envie d’entamer toute cette procédure. J’ai donc renoncé au remboursement et j’ai fini par jeter l’article.

Une politique plus juste serait de rembourser le client sans exiger le retour lorsque le produit est manifestement non conforme à la description. Cela inciterait les vendeurs à publier des annonces honnêtes et à éviter de tromper les acheteurs.

Après cette expérience, je ne commanderai plus sur AliExpress.
data.review_headline: J’ai acheté un article sur AliExpress

data.review_body:
AliExpress har blitt rene svindler bedriften. De sender varer uten å ha oppgitt VOEC nummer så du må betale toll en gang til når du skal hente ut varene. Når du så betaler toll en gang til (du har allerede betalt dette ved bestilling) og får kvittering som viser at du har betalt toll samtidig som sporingsnummer står på samme kvittering så får du bare gjentatte svar på alt du sender av dokumentasjon at det ikke er godt nok. Samme svar hver gang på tross av at posten har sendt meg alt av dokumentasjon som jeg har videresendt. E24 har en artikkel om dette som forteller at du blir lurt når du handler hos AliExpress og de ikke oppgir VOEC nummer ved forsendelse. Du kan glemme å få tilbake toll du har betalt dobbelt. De bryr seg ikke om deg som kunde. Virker ikke så veldig smarte de som gjentatte ganger ber om dokumentasjon i hver eneste mail selv om du allerede har sendt den. Hold dere unna dette svindel selskapet! 
Oppdatert 10.08.26. Nytt svar 07.08.26 fra Aliexpress om at krav er avist grunnet manglende dokumentasjon. Hele 7 ganger har de avvist kravet. De har fått all dokumentasjon de ber om og i tillegg så har jeg fått ekstra dokumentasjon fra Posten som viser at kunde ikke har lagt inn VOEC nummer på forsendelsen. Kvittering som viser betalt toll avgift ved henting samt sporingsnummer til pakken står på samme kvittering. Siden dette er en forenklet tollbehandling av posten finnes det ikke ytterligere dokumenter. Jeg har ringt og snakket med posten og de har sendt over bevis på manglende VOEC samt toll/frakt brev. Jeg har lagt ved bilde av pakken som viser fraktetikett som de og ber om. Alt er sendt til AliExpress, men samme standard avvisning hver eneste gang. De har ingen planer om å utbetale eller gå igjennom saken pånytt som de så fint skriver i svaret her. Dette har hendt meg 2 ganger ved kjøp på ebay. Sendte over kvittering fra posten som viste at jeg hadde betalt dobbel toll, melding fra ebay samme dag med beklagelse og utbetaling med en gang. Hold dere vekke fra AliExpress som bevist svindler sine kunder. 
Google VOEC på vg.no så får du opp advarsel om dette.

data.review_body:
Helaas moet ik deze beoordeling achterlaten vanwege de zeer frustrerende ervaring met AliExpress bij een verloren pakket. De afgelopen jaren veel besteld en altijd zonder problemen. Maar dit keer gaat het goed mis!

Hoewel AliExpress restitutie belooft bij pakketverlies, is de praktijk een totaal ander verhaal.

Het probleem is waarschijnlijk ontstaan bij de inklaring: er is een onjuist adres herlabeld binnen mijn woonplaats, waardoor PostNL (pakketdienst) het pakket retour heeft gestuurd naar China. Ik heb de track-and-trace URL die dit aantoont – en waaruit blijkt dat het adres niet bestaat en het pakket retour gaat – keurig met de klantenservice gedeeld. Tot mijn grote verbazing negeren ze dit bewijs volledig en meerdere keren en blijven verwijzen naar PostNL.

Ondanks het feit dat ik de feitelijke link heb aangeleverd, blijft AliExpress simpelweg beweren dat het pakket is afgeleverd en blijven ze om een 'verliescertificaat' vragen. Dit is een bureaucratische valstrik, want om in aanmerking te komen voor een vergoeding eisen ze de volgende zaken:
Een officieel verliescertificaat (loss certificate).
Dit document moet voorzien zijn van een officiële stempel/zegel van het postkantoor.
Het moet officiële informatie bevatten zoals het trackingnummer, het adres, de status van het pakket en een handtekening.
Het is volkomen absurd. Ik kan geen verliescertificaat ophalen voor een pakket dat ik nooit heb ontvangen en dat al onderweg terug naar China is. AliExpress verschuilt zich achter deze onmogelijke eisen om hun eigen verantwoordelijkheid te ontlopen, terwijl ze de concrete bewijzen die ik ze al heb gestuurd simpelweg naast zich neerleggen. Je kunt fluiten naar je geld en je pakket. Denk twee keer na voordat je hier bestelt, want bij problemen sta je er als klant alleen voor. 

=================
Reactie van Aliexpress hieronder is veelzeggend. Waardeloze reactie. Zojuist een mail van ze gekregen waarbij ze blijven bij hun standpunt dat het pakket is bezorgd, ondanks aangeleverde track and trace informatie en dat officiele, ondertekende documenten nodig zijn om het te bewijzen. Trieste bedoeling daar in China. Leven blijkbaar op te grote voet...
data.review_headline: Waardeloze klantenservice: ze negeren bewijs en eisen onmogelijke documenten

data.review_body:
I ordered three identical wall lights. The first arrived broken. Because I hadn’t filmed myself opening the parcel, AliExpress refused to refund me. Expecting customers to record themselves opening every delivery just in case an item is damaged is completely unreasonable.

Having lost confidence in the product, I returned the other two lights as soon as they arrived. AliExpress approved the return but couldn’t provide a prepaid postage label because of a technical issue, so I had to pay about £8 to return them myself. I sent the parcel using tracked postage and provided the tracking number.

About a month later, AliExpress rejected my claim, saying I hadn’t provided a photograph of the postage receipt, even though they had the tracking information and had already received the parcel. They now have the items, I’ve lost the postage cost, and they’ve refused to refund me.

When I tried to appeal the decision, the appeal page simply returned a 404 error, making it impossible to continue. That perfectly sums up my experience. The website works well when they’re taking your money, but when you need customer service or need to return something, everything seems to fall apart.

I’m now over £50 out of pocket with nothing to show for it.

I’m sure AliExpress will probably reply to this review saying they’ve investigated my case or asking me to contact them again. Based on my experience so far, I have little confidence it will lead anywhere other than another dead end. Unless AliExpress is genuinely prepared to prove me wrong by resolving this properly, I don’t see the point in going through the process again.

I’ve accepted that the money is gone. I’m writing this review simply to warn others. I wish I’d paid more attention to the other Trustpilot reviews before ordering. If anything goes wrong with your order, don’t expect the after-sales support to be anywhere near as good as the buying experience.

data.review_body:
I never thought I'd be leaving a 1-star review for AliExpress. I've used the platform for years and have always had positive experiences, which makes this situation even more disappointing. Unfortunately, this has been some of the worst customer service experience I have ever had.

I ordered an item that was delivered by InPost/Yodel. The courier ignored my delivery preferences, which were set to "Leave with a neighbour" as well as a sign on our front door stating to “never leave parcels outside”, and instead they did in fact leave the parcel unattended behind my wheelie bin while I was at work. When I returned home, the parcel had disappeared.

I immediately contacted InPost, who carried out an investigation. They confirmed in writing that the parcel had been left behind the wheelie bin, that it was not handed to me, and that it was not delivered to a neighbour and apologised. They also confirmed that if any further investigation was required, AliExpress, as the label provider, should contact them directly.

I then contacted AliExpress to explain the situation and provided all of this evidence, including the emails from InPost. 

Unfortunately, every single response I received appeared to be a generic copy-and-paste message simply stating that the tracking showed "Delivered", with no indication that anyone had actually read or understood the information I had provided. They seem to think just because an item shows as ‘delivered’ on tracking, that means it was handed to you.

I repeatedly explained that I was not disputing the tracking status. I was explaining that I never received the parcel, despite the courier confirming it had been left unattended outside rather than handed to me. Every appeal was rejected with the same generic response. Literally word for word copy-and-pasted, even when I brought up other issues separate from this current case.

At one stage, AliExpress instructed me to file a lost parcel claim with InPost. I contacted InPost again, only to be told that I could not do this because I was the recipient and only the sender (AliExpress) could pursue such a claim. I went back to AliExpress with this information, yet they still continued to tell me to contact InPost. I was effectively passed backwards and forwards between the two companies with neither taking responsibility or carrying out any meaningful investigation.

After days of emailing, providing evidence, following every instruction I was given, and exhausting every possible avenue, I was still left without my parcel and without a resolution. In the end, my only remaining option was to open a dispute through my payment service because AliExpress refused to move beyond simply checking the tracking status.

The most frustrating part of this entire experience wasn't even losing the parcel, it was the complete lack of customer service. 

I spoke to many agents on the website’s chat service, all of whom were incredibly apologetic and promising they valued my business so much they were escalating my issue to the head of office and treating me as a priority customer… However, I genuinely felt that nobody was reading my messages. Every reply ignored the tens of pictures of evidence I had provided and simply repeated the same scripted response. There was no attempt to investigate the circumstances of the delivery, no willingness to contact their own courier despite being invited to do so, and no sign that my case had ever been reviewed by a real person.

It's incredibly disappointing because AliExpress used to be a platform I trusted and recommended to others. Sadly, this experience has completely changed my opinion. When something goes wrong, the level of customer support is, in my experience, extremely poor. It used to be amazing, but I’m not sure what’s happened in the past year or so that has made them go so terribly downhill.

I sincerely hope AliExpress improves its customer service and starts properly investigating cases like this rather than relying solely on tracking updates and automated responses. No customer should have to spend days chasing two different companies, only to be left with no parcel, no refund, and no meaningful assistance.

Also, I’m fully aware they will reply to this comment with the most generic copy-and-paste response, something along the lines of “dear customer, we apologise for the inconvenience” etc and so forth… Here’s a test. If you’re actually reading this, mention me by my name Josh in the review, as well as giving other details specific to my case to prove that you’re actually investigating it.

What a tragic downhill spiral of a once solid company.

Please improve your customer service! Hire some real people instead of bots!
data.review_headline: AliExpress has changed, never ordering again! - No items delivered, No Refund!

data.review_body:
I have been a regular AliExpress customer for years, but this experience has completely destroyed my trust in their Buyer Protection.
I placed an order Ref Number:  8212135791448133 , with tracking number Tracking number:  AECA00000001015643 that clearly included the service commitment: “Refund if no delivery before July 31, 2026.”
The package was never delivered. AliExpress’s own tracking still shows:
“Delivery unsuccessful – Your package couldn’t be delivered because the recipient wasn’t at home.”
My shipping address is a commercial business that is open every day from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. The carrier (Intelcom Express) claimed they would “try again soon,” but no second delivery attempt was ever made.
The entire process has been frustrating and contradictory. AliExpress says "Delivery unsuccessful," while Intelcom's carrier tracking has remained "On the way" since July 6, 2026. I contacted Intelcom four times, but no one could tell me where my package is, whether another delivery attempt was made, or whether the package was returned to the sender. Despite this uncertainty and the lack of any proof of delivery, AliExpress still denied my refund..
I also contacted the seller, who explained that once the shipment reached Canada, they could not intervene because the local carrier was responsible.
Despite all of this, AliExpress rejected both my dispute and my appeal, claiming that I did not provide sufficient evidence.
My question is simple:  How can a customer provide proof that they did NOT receive a package?
The evidence is already on AliExpress’s own platform:
•	Order status: Awaiting delivery
•	Tracking status: Delivery unsuccessful
•	No proof of delivery
•	No signature
•	No delivery photo
•	No confirmation that I ever received the package
What made this experience even more frustrating was the dispute process itself. It honestly felt as though my case was being reviewed by robots or an automated system rather than by someone carefully examining the facts. I received generic responses asking for evidence that simply does not exist because the package was never delivered.
Once AliExpress marked the transaction as Completed, there was no way to communicate with a real person to discuss the case, explain the situation, or challenge the decision. A company handling international transactions should not hide behind automated decisions when a customer has a legitimate non-delivery dispute.
If AliExpress refuses to honor its own “Refund if no delivery” guarantee when its own tracking shows the package was never delivered, then that guarantee has no value.
What makes this even more disappointing is that I was planning to place a business order of approximately $2,000 CAD for repair parts and merchandise. Fortunately, this happened before I placed that larger order. After this experience, I no longer have any confidence that my business would be protected if another shipment failed to arrive.
I am now forced to dispute the transaction through my Desjardins Visa because AliExpress refused to resolve the issue despite my repeated attempts with both the carrier and the seller.
My advice to other buyers: As a business owner, trust is everything. I was planning to place an order of approximately $2,000 CAD for repair parts and inventory through AliExpress. Fortunately, this happened before I placed that order. After seeing how AliExpress handled a simple non-delivery case, I have decided not to risk thousands of dollars on a platform that refuses to honor its own "Refund if no delivery" guarantee and provides no way to speak with a real person once a transaction is marked as completed., and my refund was denied despite AliExpress’s own delivery guarantee.

Update (Resolved):

After posting this review and submitting a new appeal with updated evidence, AliExpress reviewed my case again.

The tracking status on both AliExpress and Intelcom was updated to confirm that the package had been lost in transit. Based on this new evidence, AliExpress approved a full refund.

I appreciate that they ultimately honored their Buyer Protection policy.

However, I remain disappointed with the dispute process. My original dispute and appeal were denied even though the package had never been delivered. It took multiple contacts with the carrier, gathering additional evidence, and another appeal before the case was finally resolved.

I hope AliExpress improves its customer service by allowing customers to communicate with a real representative when new evidence becomes available after a dispute has been closed.

data.review_body:
FR- (English below) Aliexpress profite de la mise en place de la taxe européenne sur les petits colis pour faire de l'argent sans respecter la texte de loi. Ce dernier précise que cette taxe sur le petits colis n'est pas soumise à la TVA mais s'y ajoute pourtant Aliexpress s'empresse de taxer la taxe. De plus Aliexpress n'applique pas la distinction par catégorie de produits. J'ai tenté d'acheter 2 protection de clé de voiture différentes pour une valeur totale de 5,98€ : elles appartiennent à la même catégorie d'article donc la taxe ne s'applique qu'une fois soit 3€. Pour Aliexpress c'est une protection de clé + une protection de clé + TVA soit 6,74€!!! Même si Aliexpress applique une Réduction des droits de douane leur ignorance de la loi jouera en leur défaveur par une baisse conséquente des commandes.
ENG : AliExpress is taking advantage of the introduction of the European tax on small parcels to make money without complying with the actual legislation. The law specifies that this tax on small parcels is not subject to VAT but is added on top of it; yet, AliExpress rushes to apply VAT to the tax itself. Furthermore, AliExpress fails to distinguish between product categories. I tried to buy two different car key covers with a total value of €5.98; since they belong to the same product category, the tax should apply only once (€3). For AliExpress, however, the calculation is: key cover + key cover + VAT, resulting in a total of €6.74! Even though AliExpress applies a reduction in customs duties, their disregard for the law will work against them, leading to a significant drop in orders.
Mon exemple porte sur une commande de faible valeur, pour une commande plus importante les taxes appliquées par Aliexpress deviennent abérrantes!
J'ai tenté d'expliquer, via le chat du site, en quoi Aliexpress aurait intérêt à appliquer la loi, mais je n'ai reçu comme souvent qu'une réponse bornée, robotisée et peu responsable quant à l'avantage pour sa société.

data.review_body:
Klare Warnung vor AliExpress und seinen-SHENZEN TOPLEO TECHNOLOGY LIMITED Shop .Finger weg von unseriösen AliExpress-Shops – dort auf keinen Fall bestellen

Ich schreibe diesen Beitrag aus großer Wut, Enttäuschung und Hilflosigkeit – und um andere eindringlich zu warnen. Nach meiner persönlichen Erfahrung sind viele Shops auf AliExpress absolut unseriös und handeln mit Methoden, die für mich klar nach Betrug aussehen.

In meinem Fall wurde ich mit gefälschten Versandinformationen hingehalten, bekam eine offensichtlich erfundene Trackingnummer und wurde später sogar aufgefordert, noch mehr Geld zu zahlen, obwohl bereits alles überwiesen war. Die angeblichen Tracking-Webseiten waren nichts weiter als Fake-Seiten ohne jede Verbindung zu echten Logistikfirmen. Eine echte Sendungsnummer? Wurde konsequent verweigert. Die Ware? Nie angekommen. Der Händler? Hat mich blockiert und ist verschwunden.

Was die Situation besonders bitter macht:
Selbst nachdem man den Betrug erkennt und versucht, offizielle Wege zu gehen, steht man komplett allein da. Hinweise an Plattformen, Versuche über offizielle Stellen, bis hin zu Kontaktaufnahmen mit chinesischen Behörden oder der Botschaft – keine echte Hilfe, keine Konsequenzen, keine Unterstützung. Als ausländischer Käufer ist man faktisch schutzlos.

Das alles wirkt für mich nicht wie ein Einzelfall, sondern wie ein System:
	•	Fake-Trackingnummern und eigene Betrugs-Webseiten
	•	Nachträgliche Geldforderungen
	•	Kontaktabbruch und Blockieren des Käufers
	•	Keine greifbaren Firmendaten
	•	Kein wirksamer Käuferschutz bei Überweisungen

Ich sage das ganz klar: Dort wird versucht, Menschen zu verarschen.
Man wird hingehalten, beruhigt, vertröstet – bis das Geld weg ist. Danach interessiert sich niemand mehr für einen.

Mein unmissverständlicher Appell:
Bestellt dort auf keinen Fall bei unbekannten AliExpress-Shops. Am besten bestellt man dort überhaupt nicht, vor allem nicht bei höheren Beträgen oder Zahlungen außerhalb sicherer Systeme. Das Risiko ist extrem hoch, und wenn etwas schiefgeht, bleibt man auf dem Schaden sitzen.

Ich schreibe das nicht aus Spaß, sondern aus eigener, teurer Erfahrung. Wenn dieser Beitrag auch nur eine Person davor bewahrt, Geld zu verlieren, hat er seinen Zweck erfüllt.

My experience with AliExpress customer support has been extremely disappointing.

I purchased motorcycle crash bars advertised as compatible with my CFMOTO. When they arrived, I discovered multiple manufacturing defects. The left and right crash bars had different dimensions, the mounting points did not align correctly, one threaded hole was defective, and the color was significantly different from the original CFMOTO crash bars.

Because of these defects, the crash bars could not be safely installed. Forcing them into place would put excessive stress on the motorcycle frame, so I removed them immediately.

During the dispute process, AliExpress repeatedly asked for more evidence. I provided everything requested: detailed photographs, videos, measurements, side-by-side comparisons with the original crash bars, and additional explanations. I even uploaded all the evidence to Google Drive to make their review easier.

Despite my complete cooperation, AliExpress concluded that my evidence was "not sufficient" and offered only a partial refund of €18.18 for a product that cost almost €90 and is completely unusable.

I rejected the partial refund because it was not a fair solution. Nevertheless, AliExpress processed the partial refund anyway and later stopped responding to my emails.

What disappointed me most was not only the financial loss but also the way the case was handled. I spent weeks providing evidence and following every instruction, only to receive generic responses and a decision that ignored the fact that the product cannot be used for its intended purpose.

Customers expect a fair dispute process when purchasing through a marketplace. Unfortunately, this was not my experience.

data.review_body:
Extremely disappointed with AliExpress customer support and their automated dispute system.

My order has been completely lost in transit. The tracking has had zero movement since July 4 - frozen at the departure airport in China for over a full month. The guaranteed delivery window passed long ago.

To make matters worse, a frontline support agent incorrectly opened my refund request under "Package in transit" without uploading my provided proof. This error locked the dispute interface in an automated waiting timer, removing my ability to upload evidence directly on the dispute page. When I noticed this mistake, I contacted another support agent and explicitly asked to escalate the case to the Senior Team to fix the incorrect category and attach my proof.

I have done everything possible from my side: I submitted all required proof via email and repeatedly uploaded the information and screenshots directly through the 'Reply' function in the escalation to the senior team chat. Despite this, I keep receiving generic, automated responses directing me back to the dispute page - the exact page where the upload function is blocked.

The seller has been completely passive, making empty promises while doing nothing when I asked for Cainiao investigation. AliExpress refuses to manually review the clear evidence already submitted to them. Absolute lack of proper customer support.

UPDATE – August 8, 2026

AliExpress has now finally provided the “investigation result” they referred to in their public Trustpilot response.

It took them several days to investigate the case. The result? They sent me the same Cainiao tracking link I had already checked myself countless times and stated that my parcel is “being transported under normal conditions”.

The tracking has had zero movement since July 4.

AliExpress did not explain where the parcel currently is, why there have been no tracking updates for over a month, what exactly was investigated, whether any logistics partner was actually contacted, or what information allows them to conclude that this is “normal” transportation.

I had already contacted the seller, Cainiao and AliExpress support, submitted all available evidence by email, and had the case escalated. The seller could not establish where the parcel was, and Cainiao specifically directed me back to AliExpress for resolution.

After all of that, AliExpress’ “investigation” has produced no actual information about the parcel. Instead, I was told that I will receive it no later than August 31 and that, if it still has not arrived, I should contact them again.

So the promised investigation has effectively resulted in: here is the same tracking page you already have, now wait another three weeks.

If AliExpress can state with such certainty that the parcel will arrive by August 31, I would like to know what actual evidence supports that statement when the tracking has been completely frozen since July 4.

Sending a customer the same publicly available tracking link is not an investigation result. Telling them to come back at the end of August is not a resolution.

I still have no parcel, no refund, no meaningful tracking updates and no explanation of where my order actually is.

At this point, customer support appears to exist mainly to keep the case open until the delivery timer expires rather than to resolve the problem.

After five years as an AliExpress customer, there will not be a sixth.
data.review_headline: Useless support, locked dispute loop, and lost package (Tracking frozen for more than a month)

After my first review, AliExpress publicly responded promising to "look into the issue." What followed was a series of absurd demands proving they never read my case:
My actual request: Reimbursement of 35,49€ in shipping costs (25,49€ + 10,00€ DHL invoices) because AliExpress provided an incorrect return address. The package (tracking CY731194892DE) was rejected by Chinese customs on 27.01.2026 and returned to Germany.

    Screenshot of chat with seller — I followed AliExpress instructions, not seller's
    Third-party inspection report (TÜV, SGS) — the product was returned in October 2025 and is now lost due to customs rejection

    I have two DHL invoices for the same tracking number
    I have proof of customs rejection (27.01.2026)
    Their own chat agent acknowledged the problem and escalated it (Case ID 2053808438878684)
    My chargeback (24.09.2025) covered only the product price, NOT shipping costs

AliExpress is deliberately using a broken process to avoid responsibility. They shift the blame to customers, send automated templates, and demand documents that are physically impossible to provide.
I demand: 35,49€ refund for shipping costs caused by AliExpress error. This is not about product quality — this is about compensation for costs arising from incorrect return instructions, which under EU consumer law is the seller's responsibility.
If this is not resolved, I will escalate to the European Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) platform.

The customer service makes me so angry I lose sleep over the treatment. As soon as something goes wrong, customer service makes it worse. I have lost hundreds of dollars due to them.

The last one is extremely offensive because the product got stuck in customs because they didn’t give me a receipt. I ask for one they tell me how to download it, it doesn’t exist. They forward it to customer support team, who get back to me with the exact same suggestion.it doesn’t exist when I go into the page. Eventually, I managed to get a hold of somebody through the chat, show them screenshots and they admit that sometimes it doesn’t show up so they tell me somebody will get back to me, and the person who gets back to me, says the exact same thing as everybody’s been saying yeah just download it. It doesn’t exist. Then eventually they suggest contacting the supplier, who, needless to say, does not reply and it goes back-and-forth like this wasting hours of my time until eventually we get to the point where the product has to be returned because I have not received it. It’s stuck in customs and I’ll Express will not provide me with an Invoice now what happens is even worse because their customer support team sends me emails that I can’t reply to, and there are absolute nonsense. The emails cannot be replied to because their inbox is full, so I cannot get a hold of anyone to sort out the problem. Then, when I contact them on the chat, it also ends in them, telling me a customer support agent will have a look at it and get in contact with me, who sends me an email that I can’t reply to telling me to contact customs doesn’t help because we’ve already contacted customs. They need the invoice, and I never got one and then returning the product becomes a problem because they still think that I can get a hold of customs and get the product, whilst I can’t and then they close the case because I don’t provide the information that they need now given that I can’t even email them, how am I supposed to provide them with any information or have a dialogue every time I contact them by chat it’s like starting from scratch explaining to them that it doesn’t work. I never receive the product. It’s stuck in customs. I can’t get it out so it has to be returned and I should get a refund. 

And then the audacity, to blame me for this, when I have contacted them so many times trying to solve the problem, and they have done the exact opposite on every occasion trying to not solve the problem, it makes me so furious.
I highly recommend everyone not to buy from all the Express unless they absolutely have to, because you could be losing hundreds of dollars like I have, and I suspect I’m not the only one and also I’m sure this issue will not be solved because they have showed no interest in trying to sort it out so far, and if they had read the emails that I’ve sent them or the chats with their chat button, their customer care agents then they would see how much effort I have put into trying to sort this out, and it is beyond belief.

And to add insult to injury, they offer me a 4 usd compensation, after having cost me 150 usd loss. Also, as the case has been escalated after I wrote the original complaint, it gets even worse, as they suggest contacting seller, which I already did and already told them about. They don’t read previous correspondence. This would never happen with Amazon or any other online platform. They should take this serious and they don’t.

This was my last purchase on AliExpress.
My package was officially declared lost by the courier company, Ecoscooting. They sent me an official document confirming that they take responsibility for the loss and clearly stated that I should request my refund through AliExpress.
I submitted that official document to AliExpress.
AliExpress ignored it.
Instead, they kept sending me back to the courier, while the courier kept sending me back to AliExpress. I was trapped in an endless loop where nobody wanted to take responsibility.
Even after providing official written proof that the package was lost, AliExpress rejected my appeal, claiming that I had not provided valid evidence.
At this point it became obvious that the goal was not to solve the problem, but to make the customer give up.
It was only €11, but the amount is irrelevant. The real issue is how customers are treated when something goes wrong.
I will never buy from AliExpress again. There are marketplaces that actually stand behind their buyers when a shipment is lost. Based on my experience, AliExpress is not one of them.

Review 1 – Distinctive Shoes Store

I purchased two pairs of trainers from Distinctive Shoes Store on AliExpress for a total of £138, buying them about two weeks apart. Between my purchases, the price dropped significantly to £112.

I contacted the store politely to ask whether they would consider offering some form of goodwill discount or partial refund, given the substantial price reduction shortly after my first purchase. Instead of receiving professional customer service, I was asked whether I was "trying to make trouble."

That response was completely unacceptable. Customers should be able to ask a reasonable question without being spoken to in such a dismissive and disrespectful manner.

The issue isn't simply that prices change—that happens everywhere. It's the poor attitude towards customers and the way legitimate enquiries are handled. A seller that values its customers would have responded courteously, even if the answer was no.

Based on my experience, I cannot recommend Distinctive Shoes Store. Good products mean very little when customer service is this unprofessional.

Compré una silla que ha salido defectuosa y de pésima calidad tras pocos meses de uso. Al tramitar la garantía legal que exige la normativa europea, el propio soporte de AliExpress me aprobó el reembolso íntegro por escrito.

¿La sorpresa? Pasaron los días, el dinero jamás llegó y al volver a reclamar, se lavaron las manos. Su "argumento" fue excusarse en un descuento de 15 € que me hizo el propio vendedor meses atrás como compensación por un retraso en la entrega. Pretenden usar esa compensación del vendedor para anular de forma totalmente ilegal mi derecho a la garantía por un producto que está reventado e inservible.

Respuestas automáticas de bots, negativas a cumplir lo prometido por su propio soporte y una desprotección absoluta al cliente. Además, pagarlo a través de Klarna tampoco ha servido de nada, ya que se lavan las manos e ignoran el incumplimiento del comercio.

Caso tramitado por la vía formal por incumplimiento contractual y vulneración de derechos del consumidor. No tiréis el dinero aquí en productos de importe medio/alto: en cuanto hay un problema, te dejan vendido.

data.review_body:
I am writing to expose AliExpress's absolute lack of respect and their deceptive advertising practices towards consumers. The platform offers no real support, protects sellers of counterfeit items, and misleads customers with their fake "Free Return" labels.

1. Complicity with Counterfeit Products: I purchased a Micro SD Card that proved to be fake (it did not have the advertised capacity or speed). Instead of banning the seller, AliExpress made it incredibly difficult to return a clearly fraudulent item.

2. The "Free Return" Trap: All my purchased products had the "Free Return" label. However, upon initiating the return process, I was forced to pay the shipping costs upfront via CTT (Portugal Post), which cost me an absurd total of 70.70 Euros (13.20€ to Madrid and 57.50€ to China).

3. False Promises from Customer Service (Evidence Attached): Before shipping the items and paying this fortune out of pocket, I contacted the official AliExpress chat. Agents "Hammad" and "Muhammad" GUARANTEED me, in writing, that AliExpress would generate a coupon to cover my shipping costs if the seller refused to pay. Trusting the company's official word, I shipped the items.

The result? Their automated robotic system closed my disputes and refuses to issue the promised refund, claiming "incomplete documentation" or stating that the shipping is my responsibility due to the return reason I was forced to select in their rigid, broken system. I provided all the official CTT receipts, showed the proof of payment, and attached the screenshots of their own agents promising the reimbursement. Nothing worked. Their customer service is an endless robotic loop that completely ignores solid evidence.

It is unacceptable for AliExpress to advertise "Free Returns," explicitly instruct the customer to pay for shipping with a promise of full reimbursement, and then flatly deny the payment, leaving the consumer at a financial loss and without the products.

data.review_body:
AliExpress verlangt von mir Nachweise dafür, dass ich eine Sendung nicht erhalten habe. Diese Forderung ist jedoch widersinnig, denn wie soll ich den Nichterhalt einer Sendung beweisen? Den maßgeblichen Zustellnachweis mit Unterschrift oder anderen Zustellunterlagen kann ausschließlich der Absender (AliExpress) bei DHL anfordern.

Mit anderen Worten: AliExpress verlangt von mir Nachweise, die nur AliExpress selbst bei DHL beschaffen kann, weigert sich aber gleichzeitig, diese anzufordern. Solange das nicht geschieht, lässt sich weder überprüfen, wer die Sendung tatsächlich erhalten hat, noch kann der versicherte Versand ordnungsgemäß untersucht werden.

Ich werde mein Geld wohl also nicht wiedersehen, obwohl AliExpress für den Schaden gar nicht aufkommen muss. Sie müssen nur die von mir überstellte Empfängererklärung an DHL geben und dort einen Nachforschungsantrag stellen. Aber das ist AliExpress offenbar zu lästig. 

Auch dem Paypal Käuferschutz habe ich das alles genau geschildert und alle Dokumente wie Screenshots von der Sendungsverfolgung usw. hochgeladen. Paypal scheint das aber auch zu lästig zu sein und sie haben abgelehnt mit der Begründung, dass die DHL Sendungsverfolgung sagt, das Paket sei zugestellt. 

Genau das war ja aber der Punkt, weshalb ich Paypal eingeschaltet habe. DHL sagt zugestellt, es ist aber nichts bei mir angekommen und AliExpress legt die Hände in den Schoß. 
  
Fazit: Nie wieder AliExpress und Paypal-Konto werde ich kündigen. 

Update (7-8-2026): An der Antwort die AliExpress hier unten hinschreibt könnt Ihr alle genau nachvollziehen, was ich meine. AliExpress begreift (vermutlich absichtlich) nicht, dass der Versender den Vertrag und die Versandversicherung mit DHL geschlossen hat und mir DHL daher immer nur sagt, dass ich schlicht nicht berechtigt bin, Auskünfte einzuholen oder einen Nachforschungsauftrag zu erteilen.
 
AliExpress wälzt also die eigene Verantwortung einfach auf die Kunden ab, die dann nichts mehr tun können. Wie gesagt, der Beweis ist die Antwort, die AliExpress hier unten hingeschrieben hat. Und paypal spielt dieses Spielt munter mit. Es gibt keinen Käuferschutz.  

Ich erstatte morgen Anzeige wegen des Verdachts auf Fälschung meiner Unterschrift sowie Zustellbetrugs bei der Polizei. Der einzige Weg, der mir noch bleibt. Und ich rufe Euch alle auf: Tut es mir nach! Nur so bekommen wir Händler wie AliExpress sowie paypal wieder in den Griff.
data.review_headline: Sendung nicht zugestellt: AliExpress weigert sich das mit DHL zu klären
